batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c S Badrinath b Joginder Sharma

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b JDP Oram

batting.name: RT Ponting
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b JDP Oram

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c S Badrinath b P Amarnath

batting.name: Mohammad Hafeez
batting.dismissal: c Joginder Sharma b P Amarnath

batting.name: AB Agarkar
batting.dismissal: c M Muralitharan b MS Gony

batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b AB Agarkar

balls.text: driven to extra cover

that's gone and what fine thinking by the fielders, Shukla can't do much with the yorker and Ishant wants a single, Dhoni throws the ball back to Joginder but the bowler doesn't take the bails off immediately, Ishant is walking back to the pavilion and Shukla is outside the crease when Dhoni  signals to Joginder to take the bails off before Parthiv forces him to break the stumps. At the point when the bowler did that, Shukla was out and Ishant in. The two keepers (Dhoni and Parthiv) engineered that.
tries the paddle again but he deceives him there, too far outside off and a wide given there, so the batsman is fooled but not the umpire
lofts it tentatively over extra cover, not in control but he's at the other end. Lokhi to face
dug out a yorker and scamper a single, Ishant to face now
cheeky, very cheeky, he goes the Misbah way this time, walking across and executing the falling sweep well, the falling paddle almost, over short fine leg for a single
full and outside off, crashed it violently through extra cover, burns the grass
good thinking there, taps it in front of him and gets a quick single, Oram tries to knock off the stumps at the striker's end but misses, Ishant is safe
slower bouncer again but Shukla is waiting, on the back foot and pulled away furiously for four, short midwicket has no chance
crisp drive first up, outside off and he gives Lokhi the strike
full and on middle, worked away hastily to the leg side
slower one again, Kartik is too early on the shot, checks his shot and offers a simple skier to the bowler, simple caught and bowled, Kolkata slide deeper
yorker to start with, dug out towards midwicket
full again, Kartik gives himself room and drives to extra cover
in the blockhole this time, digs it out and takes a quick single to mid-on, Joginder fires in a direct hit but Shukla was in the crease by then, third umpire says not out and the crowd roars
tapped away to the off side, back of a length that time
worked away for a single
slower one again and he's holed out, Agarkar checks his shot this time, lazy loft to long-on and Murali is waiting for the catch there, he doesn't drop them and Gony picks up his second.
a slower yorker this time, more a low full toss, scoops it in the air and drops just short of short midwicket, Joginder can't get there this time, good start to the over
full one, driven powerfully down the ground but Oram cleans up at long-off
oversteps this time, slower one that's pushed back to the bowler, but Agarkar gets a chance to swing his arms. Replays show that it's a close call. The umpire might have been a bit harsh there.
short and sharp, pulled away towards midwicket for a single, not in control but they'll take them at this stage
another full one, swinging a shade away, Shukla swings mightily but can't make contact, trying to hit that too hard, it seems
125kph, shaping away from the batsman, full one that time, driven crisply past cover for another one
pushed to the on side for a quick single
short of a length, blitzed away superbly, that's a flat hit over midwicket for six, Lokhi can hit them and this is the time he needs to take off, crisp strike that
driven down the ground
swept away but no timing again, has to settle for the single after the ball bobs off bat, pad, glove and many other implements
offbreak that turns sharp, pushed to cover
mis-stumping, tossed up outside leg stump, Shukla jumps down the track but is nowhere close to the ball, Dhoni has a big chance but is looking at the batsman than at the ball, missed chance
reverse-sweep tried but can't get it in the middle of the bat, Agarkar wants a single but he's sent back
driven back down the ground, a single to mid-off
tossed up outside leg, turning in but Shukla sweeps it ferociously to fine leg, drops short of the fielder but well done by Gony there. Keeps them down to a single
full and outside off, Agarkar chips that in the air but finds the gap, what's more he even manages a quick two
start as you go, short and wide and the typical Agarkar clash over point for four, no point bowling there to him, the fielder made a fine jump but just missed out

another wicket! and what a catch! Hafeez tries to paddle it cutely towards fine leg but Joginder is at short fine leg and alert enough to pouch a low, sharp chance, the batsman walks and Palani is over the moon. Kolkata yet to reach 100 and have little to play with now. Deep trouble
full and on middle and leg, good nippy stuff here, tucked away behind square
full outside off, slashed away to extra cover for a single, Hafeez needs to play an important innings here, he's well set and can hit it long
full and outside leg, not the line to be bowling, turned away to the fine-leg boundary for four. Fine leg is up so the bowler had no chance
quicker one on the pads, no room for Shukla  to play with, strikes him on the pads
slower one outside off, tapped away towards third man
short of a length, rising on the batsman, pushes tentatively to the cover region, this is good bowling from Joginder
another slower one, that's obviously a tactic now, too early again and chipped over short midwicket, he's really teasing the fielders

another slower one, there's all over the place now, too early on the shot and he chips it airily towards mid-off, drops short but Raina is thinking on his feet, gets a direct hit. It's close but the batsman is in
120.6kph, short of a length, turned away to midwicket
this is even slower, 101kph, and it's a bouncer this time, deceives the batsman and soars over his head, all bowlers trying this slow bouncer now
another slower one, this one is just 106kph, short-arm jab to midwicket for a single
111.4kph, outside off and giving the batsman no room to play with, Hafeez tries  to glide it to third man but only manages an inside edge down to the ground, trickles back to the keeper
slower one this time, full and outside off, tapped to the third-man region for a single
finally a four, short one and Shukla (Lokhi) pulls it away in a controlled fashion, in front of square and runs away for four, they need more of those
punched away off the back foot, an easy two to deep cover, quick running there
another one that's short of a length and tough to play, batsman on his toes and defending to the off side
128kph, full and swinging into the pads, driven off the back foot but the fielder comes around to stop that
full one on the pads, worked away to fine leg, he could have put that one away for four
another one with good bounce, just 123kph but this pitch is offering good bounce, disconcerting lift close to his rib-cage, taps it hesitantly to the third man region, he could have been hit by that
drives a full on to extra-cover, 13 singles in the last five overs, no four in there, pressure telling now
120.3kph, short of a length and rising, good carry to the keeper, the batsman tries to angle his bat but beaten, could have been a soft dismissal
80.4kph, starts from leg and spins away, another doosra, he's mixing them well, pushed to the on-side
quicker outside off, glided to third man
another flighted ball, defended cautiously to the on side
82kph, tossed up a bit that time, pushed to cover for a quick one
full and on off, turning in, sweeping towards fine leg for a single
doosra this time, starts from off and turns away, Hafeez tries to work it to mid-on but can only get a thick edge towards point
tucked away to the leg side
pushed a full one to to extra-cover

slower bouncer this time, 118kph, Shukla surprised with that one, ducks under it, wake up call, that. Lot of slow bouncers in this tournament. Pollock, Brett Lee, Joginder now. Somewhere, Andy Roberts is smiling.

Ganguly falls! a slower one this time, outside off again, Ganguly tries to loft it over the infield but a leading edge balloons up straight to Badrinath at cover, he keeps his eye on the ball and doesn't make any mistake, this is big trouble now. Chennai well and truly on top.
full and well outside off, tries to slash it through the off side, straight to extra-cover, can't make proper contact
short of a length, inside-edged onto the body, ball trickles away to third man for a quick single
tossed up outside off, pushed to mid-on for another single, Kolkata need some big overs soon, the run-rate is dipping alarmingly
pushed down the ground, good bit of fielding by Murali - one-handed save that deflects the ball towards mid-off - but they manage a single
outside leg again, struck on the pads but you can't give those (Dhoni appeals but no use again)
too far down the leg side, he's trying to start from wide and get it away
outside leg stump and the doosra this time, on the front foot and pushing to the leg side
another offbreak, turned away in the gap square off the wicket
pitches outside off and spins in, tentatively defended down the ground
cramps him for room, tucked to the short midwicket region for a single
full and outside off, moving away, good shape from Palani, left alone by the batsman. Dhoni collects that waist height
yorker-length this time, digs it out well but no run again
125kph, straight and good-length ball, pushed to the on side

another one, Palani strikes, short and wide, not the greatest of balls but cut straight to point for an easy catch to Badrinath. David Hussey could have put that anyway but struck it to the fielder. Amarnath comes back well after conceding the most expensive over in the tournament (in the last match). His famous line of victims read: Tendulkar, Shaun Pollock, David Hussey
full and outside off,  glided away cautiously to third man
tapped square for a single, retains the strike
too far down the leg side, that was left alone for a wide
turned away to the leg side, another dot ball, this must be frustrating for the Kolkata side
on the back foot this time, pitched outside leg, big appeal but you can't give those, any plans of scoring runs, Sourav?
down the track that time, but not to the pitch, decides to work it away
pushed back to the bowler, he's fired that in
quicker one, outside off and spinning away, tries to jab at it but can't make contact
drives a full ball to the covers, that region is packed now

Castled! You can fool some of the people all of the time ... Gony has final laugh, full and jags back in, through the gate and crashes into middle and off, he's bowled a fine over, conceded a four and a six to sharp deliveries and struck back well, rewarded for some fine bowling

and again, short again, rising uncomfortably and Saha has simply taken his eyes off the ball and tried another pull, another top-edge, another four over the keeper, nice tactic this from Saha (though all seems unintentional) ... that carried over the ropes for a six. Playing in the V, it seems
edgy but that's four again, Gony digs it in short and Saha goes for the pull, surprised with bounce and pace, top-edge flies away over the keeper for four, Saha thriving here
short of a length, angled away to third man for a single, deciding to give Saha the strike, it seems.
short ball but can't get that away, Ganguly tries to pull it away but can't get the timing right, falls close to his feet, Gony is growing in stature with every ball

moves across and shovels this one over midwicket, another four, this is a fine way to ease the pressure, Saha showing his worth. We've seen how well he can keep. Now he's showing how good a batsman he is
innovative and effective, shuffles across and paddles that (Misbah style) past fine leg for four, Amarnath is a bit shocked but fine improvisation from Saha
breaks the shackles, lifts a full one straight down the ground, mid-off has no chance, races away for four
square drives a short-of-a-length ball to point but no run again
pushed to cover, they think of a quick single but the Chennai cover cordon is alert as ever

Fine start, full and straight, raps him on the pads, big appeal but there's more drama. Saha takes off for the single but the fielder at cover (Raina) picks it up and gets a direct hit. It goes upstairs. But Saha is just back in. Close but not out. Replays show the lbw appeal was close but the ball was possibly travelling above the stumps. All happening.
drives a full ball towards covers, can't get the placement
short of a length again, 133kph, using his 6'4" to good effect, cramping the batsman for room, who can only defend it down near his toes
crisply struck to the covers but straight to Michael Hussey at cover, crisp strike from Saha to a ball that was slightly short of a length
edged and that's gone between keeper and wide first slip, short of a length, good teasing ball there, beaten by the slight seam movement and that's four in the gap.
angling into the batsman this time, tries to flick it across the line but plays it back to the bowler, good bowling from Gony here, after a demolition in the previous over
drives a full ball to mid-off, time for some consolidation it seems, Ganguly playing it watchfully and picks up a single
inside edge that's stabbed towards mid-on
full and straight, Saha cautiously turns it to the leg side

and he goes first ball, that's his second first-ball duck in the tournament, pushes a full ball in the air but that's straight to Suresh Raina at cover, he's mobbed by his mates in no time and this sell-out crowd is going bananas

got 'em, Oram strikes, this is a huge wicket, McCullum was looking for another big score, full ball on middle and he tries to flick it to the leg side but can only manage a leading edge, pops up to the extra-cover fielder who makes no mistake, Chennai erupts
huge, this is a monster hit, short and pulled away off the front foot, he's timing them from the sweet spot and that's soared over deep midwicket for a biggie
cut away past point, good placement and they scamper two, quick work that time
full and on off, slightly slower this time, pushed to mid-on, fine over for Kolkata. 16 from it.
short, wide and blitzed away, screams past point for another four, 4,6,4, he's beginning to motor now
massive! pick-up shot from middle stump and swivels around to deposit that behind square for a big hit, slightly short and that was enough for Mac the Knife
those are the kind of shots you call "stand and deliver", short of a length, bit of bounce, but he backs away and swats furiously through mid-off for four, straight and brutal
good ball but he's overstepped, 131kph this time and doesn't give him room outside off but McCullum gets a free hit
pace and bounce, 130kph, starts outside off and seams away, McCullum swings hard, really hard, but can't make contact
on the money straight away, McCullum moves across but can only push it towards cover, cramped for room there
too much width, uses the room and spanks it past point for the first four of the game
on and outside off, crisply struck by Ganguly but Badrinath is prowling there, fine stop that stops the run, that was well timed
pushed a good-length ball to mid-on for a quick single, the din is getting louder and louder, it's a packed house at Chepauk
short of a length, McCullum takes a step forward but needs to defend it off his toes to the off side
glided away towards short third man, Michael Hussey puts in a good stop but can't stop the single
down the leg side, clipped away behind square for a couple, football-style stop at fine leg, Ganguly is away
seals it with a six, down the ground and a big hammer over long-on for a big one, finishes it in style
pushed through to middle and leg, turned away to leg side
punched off the back foot to mid-on, easy single
89kph, on the pads, turned away to midwicket for a single
down the leg side and easily done, helped along to fine leg for a four, only five needed now
full and straight, pushed down the ground for a single. 18 off the over, a big one for Chennai
waist-high full toss, Dhoni cracks that down the ground, that would have been close to a no-ball, Hayden back on strike
full and on off stump, carved away to the off side
smack, hard and straight, standing tall and blitzing that way over the bowler for a big one, this is all ending too fast, Chennai going bananas. Time for a bath at the Marina.
backs away, gives room, sliced away over extra-cover for a couple, Hayden in a hurry to finish this off, it seems
that was too short and too wide down leg side, attempted bouncer all gone wrong, over the batsman, over the keeper and all the way for four
short one to begin with and Hayden walks down the ground and pulls it forcefully, good bit of fielding at the boundary but they manage two anyway
short of a length, cut away powerfully wide of third man, lot of power behind that but the fielder cleans it up
doesn't get better, full and on middle, swept away delicately past short fine for four, power followed by a kiss, a grenade before the flower. Super
too short and too wide, Dhoni simply stands and swishes, big flourish that, top-edge that flies away through third man for four
waist-high full toss and was lucky not to pay for that, Dhoni swings hard but straight to the fielder, tough stop for him
yorker outside off, Hayden throws his bat like a broom and rattles that past point
full and on middle stump, driven hard down to long-on
and that's his fifty, full outside off, slices it towards point and brings up his second consecutive fifty of the tournament
down the ground, tries to repeat the shot but can only get an inside edge to backward square leg
pushed away to midwicket for a single
fires it in, on the back foot and cut away to extra cover for a single
whoa! that is just too big, down the ground and blasted that way, way over midwicket for a six, scorcher that one, 83 metres it says, what a biggie
tries to pull that but struck on the pads, scamper a quick single
slightly slower that time, pulls but can't get the timing right, bobs off the pad and down the ground
tries for the paddle-sweep, changes his shot to the glide to third man, dabs it away for a single
full and driven to long-on for a single
jabbed away hard towards extra cover, that was a short of a good length ball, quick two that time
127.4kph, yorker this time, dug out straight down the ground, thinks of a single but good stop by Laxmi, fires it back to the keeper
full and on leg, pumped away in front of square
faster one, Hayden walks down the ground and nonchalantly drills it to long-off
quicker on middle and leg, pushed back down the ground
too short that time, pulled away hard to the vacant midwicket region, that was struck with power and beats the fielder
backs away and taps it towards cover for a single
dances down the track, takes it on the full, patted away in the air towards mid-off,
over the wicket to the left-hander, walking down and lifting towards long-on, just short of Agarkar there, more like a chip shot from Hayden
inside edge that time, slower ball and Hayden goes for the big hit over midwicket, deflected wide of short fine leg
134kph, good-length ball on middle, Hayden tries to glide to third man before changing his shot finally - tapping to mid-off
full and good flick from Hayden, taken from outside off and in the gap at deep square leg, easy two that time
short of a length, cut away in the gap this time
tapped away towards cover, good line from Agarkar
full and straight, Dhoni drives hard into the ground, Ajit stops it with a good jump, that could have easily been a four
traipses down the track and taps in the gap for another single
full and on off this time, cut away in the gap for a single, they just need ones now, no pressure at all
pushed to long-on for an easy single
short of a length, spins a bit, looks to come down the track but cuts from the crease in the end, airy flash but drops short of the fielder at short third man, that beat him
full toss and he's driven powerfully towards wide long-off, too easy now, Kolkata need to get some fielders in
full and on middle and off, driven to long-off for a single
moves a bit across and taps it towards short midwicket, thinks of a second but a loud "no" goes off, he's quick between the wickets
short of a length, tapped back down the ground, has all the time to get his eye in now
slower one, tapped sensibly to the off side and they take a quick one
full and outside off, tries to cut hard but the inside edge races away past the keeper for four, that was good bowling but no luck for Agarkar

that's the first one, short and quick, targets the head of the batsman, goes for the pull but can only get the top edge, sails straight to deep fine leg where Ishant laps up a simple catch. Good change of pace by Agarkar, surprised Parthiv there
full and on middle and leg, driven hard but straight to mid-on, they are cruising now
driven to long-on for a single, easily done
down the leg side again and he lets it go, called a wide and rightly so
paddle-swept to fine leg for a single
defended to the off side
he's eaten that up like he would a giant hamburger, stands tall, backs away, swings clean and sees the ball soar over the ropes, what a strike, he's such a brutal hitter
90.1kph, yorker on off stump, turned away towards midwicket, another single
starts from round the wicket too, quicker one but he angles the bat towards third man and takes off, good run
tapped back to the bowler, they think of a single but decide against it
on-driven neatly
what a monster! walks down the track and pummels it way, way over midwicket for a biggie, Ponting just had a word with Hussey before that ball but it obviously doesn't work.
worked away to the leg side for a single
dropped, really tough caught-and-bowled chance but Hussey can't hold on, smacked back hard and Hussey doesn't have time to react
tossed up outside off, Parthiv lifts over extra cover, not well timed but they get the single
slower one again, Hayden backs away and tries to glide past the short third man but can't get the placement, no point running for that one, too risky
tries to tip and run a quick single but Parthiv sends him back, the point fielder is quick
tucked away towards short fine leg for a single
slower one this time, on the pads and Hayden is fooled, can't make proper contact but they get a quick single to one that trickles to the off side, good call by Parthiv
that was dangerous, full and straight and Hayden nearly decapitated Parthiv with that biff down the ground, Parthiv is ducking for cover in the non-striker's end and the two batsmen share a laugh.
Hayden welcomes him with a four, full outside off and he's lofted that wide of mid-off for a four, that was not from the middle of the bat but he gets a four anyway
124kph, change of pace again, short and a bit too wide again, Parthiv in place for the shot but can't get the placement right, straight to cover
122.5kph, slow one and that was carefully punched to cover for a single
he's broken the shackles, short of a length and a bit of width, stands still and cuts hard, behind backward point for four, in the air but that was in the gap
short of a length and Hayden mis-times that again, thick bottom-edge to cover, he's not found the sweet spot of the bat yet
angles his bat to get a sensible single to third man
too short and a bit too wide, Parthiv stands tall and creams that over point for a ferocious four, that was struck with immense power, for a little man he can pack a punch
good finish, good-length ball outside off, driven straight to the point fielder
138.1kph, short of a length, Hayden, rooted to the crease, tries to pull but doesn't make contact, sails through to the keeper
left alone, moves away a bit from Ishant, short of a length
short this time, Parthiv tries to pull but the ball keeps low, big appeal by the keeper and slips but Ishant isn't too interested, that pitched outside leg, looked like, they scamper a leg bye.
full and on middle and off, better line this time, tucked to mid-on
Parthiv's taken full advantage of that, full ball and he opens the face to spank that over point for four, takes one step back and rattles it
over-steps this time, glided away to third man for a single but Ishant has given a free hit now.
square driven but straight to the fielder, good pace from Dinda but he's conceding too many runs for Kolkata's liking.
that's taken off like Apollo II. Too short and that's lifted off alarmingly over the keeper's head for four byes. He's bowling to Parthiv, remember. So that looked even higher.
full and outside off, Parthiv goes for the mighty drive but is beaten, bit of movement away from the bat
another one that's slightly short and wide, they seem to be testing Hayden with a plan here, no timing again but they pick up a single
140kph this time, short of a length again, he goes for the cut, bottom edge that time and can't get the timing, the fielder is cleaning up
another slash and this time it's the bottom edge that squirts past the second slip for four, no chance for Ponting there, Hayden is looking to go for it
short of a length, 137kph, Hayden waits but the ball kicks off a bit more than he expects, can't make contact with the cut
full and on middle, driven tentatively towards short midwicket, Ganguly fields that easily, just 3 from Ishant's first over
sliding down the legs, Parthiv tucks square neatly, they get an easy couple, wrong length from Ishant
short of a length, on middle and leg this time, tucked away to the leg side, again the fielder is there on time, good pace from Ishant
140kph, pushed a full one to mid-off, crisply struck but can't get the placement
walking down the ground and trying to make room, Ishant sees that and fires it in on the pads, the ball deflects off the pads and runs away towards point
140.5kph first up, good-length ball outside off, Hayden punches it towards mid-on but straight to the fielder, good start from Ishant
full and on middle and leg, swinging in, Parthiv tries to flick it square but is beaten by the pace, Dinda is nippy, neat action too
too short and a bit of width, spanked away square for a four, the fielder puts in a dive but but can't stop that one
142kph this time, he's cranking it up, good-length ball outside off, stabs at it but the ball bounces and goes straight to second slip
137.7kph, left alone outside off then, no hurry for the batsmen, this asking-rate is well within reach
too wide that, short too, Parthiv has a slash but can't get there, Bowden doesn't spare that
left alone outside off, a bit of shape for Dinda away from the left-hander
130.4kph to start with, short of a length and mis-timed to point.
